decisions.reason: It remained prominently listed through 2024, which suggests performance at or above aspiration levels, so a mature German manufacturer would likely continue it unless results deteriorate clearly.
As a 2024 launch with its own page, it is still in the learning phase, and with bounded rationality and some organizational slack the firm would usually keep it for another year to judge demand.

Its weaker website presence signals a more tentative commitment and somewhat higher risk of falling short of aspirations, but because it is very new the firm would likely retain it one more year before reallocating resources.
